The position of '''Staff Chief''' was held by those beings who acted as aides and coordinators for politicians, executing the will of the figure whom they served.

==History==
Staff Chiefs were active in the days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and held office under the auspices of the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]], which could strip a staff chief of his or her rank if need be. In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], [[Victor Pomt]], Staff Chief for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Viqi Shesh]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], was implicated in a corruption scandal and was stripped of his rank pending investigation. Pomt was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], however, before the investigation could take place.
